ios.desc:
Discover the events happening around you and talk to the people who'll be there.

Convosphere shows you what's going on nearby right now: drinks, gigs, pickup games, walks, nights out that come together on the spot. Pick your radius, see what's on, join the conversation. Numbers are never swapped, and nobody has to be added as a friend.

Privacy
Messages are protected with end-to-end encryption: only you and the person you're talking to can read them. Your number is never swapped: you give it only to the people you choose. No profile to fill in, no friend requests to send.

Events near you
Your feed shows events within the radius you choose, sorted by distance and time. Filter by today, by the weekend, by category. Every event shows the place, the time, how many spots are left, and who has already said they're coming.

Event channels
Every event gets its own channel. Ask where everyone is meeting, say you're running late, find each other when you arrive. The conversation lives as long as the event does.

GeoChat
Zone chat: talk in real time with whoever is inside the radius you picked. You're in as soon as you open it.

Create your own event
Pick a category, set the time, the place and the number of spots, publish. It takes thirty seconds. Anyone nearby sees it.

Private chats
Photos, voice messages and files, in one-to-one conversations.

For organisers
A direct line to the people who are already in the area: no lists, no sign-ups, no ads to buy.

Convosphere started in Bologna. If nothing is happening in your city yet, create the first event and see who shows up.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Convosphere – Real-life proximity chat

quotes.text:
The idea for Convosphere came to me a few years ago, when I was visiting a friend in Sardinia. I had just landed at the airport and needed to get to the train station. I wanted to share a taxi with someone else but didn’t feel like going around asking people one by one. That’s when it struck me: what if there were an app that allowed me to instantly connect with everyone nearby – like a group chat for people in the same location? That became the seed of the project.

On the technical side, Convosphere is built with Flutter for cross-platform development, and the backend currently runs on Firebase+Firestore. The app is available as a web app, Android, and iOS, and it supports location-based group and one-to-one chat, events, and a trust score system for safer interactions.

You can try Convosphere at the following links:

WebSite: https://site.convosphere.app/

WebApp: https://convosphere.app/

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convosphere.convosphere

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/it/app/convosphere/id6737458247

Feedback welcome!
